title_block.title: Recipe Card Training Record: Revisions, Units and Pilot Lot Handoff
title_block.subtitle: Training completion record, signed

blocks.p: This record shows that the staff named in section 3 completed training on the recipe card revision set issued in July 2025. It also records the training on unit conventions and on the pilot lot handoff checklist, which the scale team now uses at every scale gate.

Training was given in the formulation room over three sessions. Each trainee read the revised cards against the bench sheets they had used, and the assessor discussed any card where the bench practice had drifted from the written process.

list: A new recipe card revision needs reviewer sign-off before it is issued to the bench.
The superseded card is moved to the archive, not deleted, and the bench sheets that cite it keep their reference.
A card revision that changes a dose or loading assumption is also raised with the formulation development lead.

blocks.p: Concentrations are written in mg/mL. Loadings are written in weight percent, with the basis stated. Particle sizes are written in µm with the measurement method. Every value carries its unit beside it. A bare number on a card or a sheet is returned to the author, however small the change.

Trainees were asked to convert a blend described in weight percent into its mg/mL concentration and back. Two of the cards in the set had been written with the loading in one unit and the concentration in the other, and these were corrected at the session.
The handoff checklist lists the items that must travel with a pilot lot. Each item has a named owner, and an item is not closed until the owner has initialed it on the handoff sheet.

list: Recipe card number, revision letter and issue date.
Concentrations in mg/mL for each stock and the final formulation.
Loading in weight percent for each component, with the basis stated.
Dose assumption, its basis and its source.
Particle size in µm, the method used and the date measured.
Storage location of the retained material, as recorded by Sample Management.
Each open manufacturability risk, its owner and the date it must close.

blocks.p: Each trainee's completion is recorded below. The assessor for each module signed the trainee's line on the day.

Miguel Serrano and Piergiuseppe Abbagnale are not on the list. Both completed the revision control module in June 2025 under the earlier card set, and the July revisions were discussed with them at the formulation meeting.

Each trainee answered the short written check on the revised cards. Every trainee passed the revision control and units modules on the first attempt. Two trainees needed a second attempt at the handoff checklist, and the assessor went through the handoff sheet with them before the second attempt. Both passed.

The assessor's view is that the training achieved its purpose. The main remaining risk is in the handoff, where the owner for an open manufacturability risk is sometimes left blank. The checklist now requires a name before the sheet is accepted.

This record is filed with the Quality training files. Signed copies are held by the CMC group. Training records for staff who later leave the group stay in the archive with the staff directory entry for that person, and their personal working folders are retained as archive material.
